items.title: Lorraine Feather interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, March 22, 2023
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] My name is Monk Rowe... [INTERVIEWEE] Thank you, Monk, for inviting me.

ctx.x: My name is Monk Rowe for the Fillius Jazz Archive and boy am I pleased to have Lorraine Feather with me this morning. Welcome. Thanks for your time.
Thank you, Monk, for inviting me.
I’m going to introduce you as a vocalist, a lyricist, a wordsmith, and I believe a very active, creative mind.
